functions.name: respond
functions.description: Answer an ext: handler request delivered through onHandoffRequest (the browser-side hand-off engine is spinning, bounded, waiting for this). Respond as soon as the target extension acknowledged or declined.

functions.name: getHandlers
functions.description: Read the download hand-off handler rows with their probe states, as [{index, id, kind, label, hint, args, enabled, available, detail}] - the same rows the Settings > General editor shows. Throws when this build has no hand-off engine (USE=download-handoff off), which is how the options page decides to hide its download-managers section.

functions.name: refreshProbes
functions.description: Re-run the availability probes (uget-integrator version handshake, cmd: PATH lookups) so the next getHandlers() reports fresh states. Throws when this build has no hand-off engine.

events.name: onHandoffRequest
events.description: Fired when the browser-side hand-off engine (Settings > General > Download hand-off) reaches an ext:<id> handler and asks this relay to deliver the download message to that extension. The relay must answer with respond() - the engine's wait is bounded and a missing answer declines the download.
